title: 配達員の季節業務

subject_en: A Japanese man delivery worker in his 30s, tan cap, navy delivery jacket, black pants, small plain parcel box, simple line-and-color style with thin navy outline and light fills, energetic but neutral, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
